Definition: from G2596 and G190; to accompany closely:--follow (after).
BiblicalUsage: The women followed after Joseph to see where the body was laid, and the damsel with the spirit of divination followed Paul crying out that these men were the servants of the most high God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe following closely is how the truth is learned, whether by friends at the tomb or by a voice that will not be quiet.
